allies.rationale_text: Systems-thinking helps agile-methodologies see interdependencies and feedback loops instead of treating sprint activity as isolated local work.
allies.source_quote: Agile’s need for continuous adaptation aligns directly with Systems Thinking.
allies.affinity_rationale: Described as 'aligns directly with Systems Thinking' — seeing interrelationships and feedback loops in complex implementations, 'exposing the complexity' that Agile must manage.
allies.activation_condition: When sprint-level execution needs to account for system-wide interdependencies and feedback loops rather than treating tasks as isolated work items

allies.rationale_text: Experimentation gives agile-methodologies the test-everything discipline needed to turn iteration into real learning instead of opinion recycling.
allies.source_quote: testing every single possibility and comparing outcomes
allies.affinity_rationale: The canonical article describes hypothesis-driven problem solving as 'a core ally' — the disciplined test-everything approach that converts sprint cycles into genuine learning rather than opinion recycling.
allies.activation_condition: When iterative delivery needs a test-everything discipline to convert sprint cycles into genuine validated learning rather than recycled assumptions

antagonists.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias turns agile-methodologies into ritualized hypothesis protection by using sprints to confirm a favored conclusion.
antagonists.source_quote: This disciplined approach minimizes the risk of confirmation bias.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Generic confirmation bias applied to the Agile context — 'hypothesis-driven sprints are used to confirm a mandated conclusion' — the mechanism is about misuse of Agile rather than a specific anti-Agile force.
antagonists.activation_condition: When sprint hypotheses are pre-determined to confirm a mandated conclusion rather than genuinely testing the underlying assumptions
